Double Breaker
■ When you put this creature into the battle zone, or at the start of your turn, gacharange summon. Gacharange Summon
■ Each of your gacharange creatures gets "speed attacker".
■ Each of your non-gacharange creatures gets "Guardman".

Double Breaker

■ 自分のGRクリーチャーすべてに「スピードアタッカー」を与える。
